synth.notes:
Frame-native mirror-axis rule: parse 21x21 blocks of 3x3 (10 axis, 5 piece, 11 target, 4 reflection, 9 bg), selection = 0 centres.
A1/A2 move selection one block row; A3/A4 move selected piece (blocked by edge/other pieces), axis A3/A4 no-op.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis. Reflections at row 2A-r, skipping axis row, off-board and piece cells.
HUD col 63 gains one 12 from the top per effective action only (no-op A3 does not tick).
Hidden-state hypothesis not needed: rule is stateless; tie order of equal-size pieces in A5 and axis-row blocking are unconfirmed.
